jsAbortCauseProjection: Only new JS rows rename old ABORT c to cause; c remains execution context alias. Original v1 c is unchanged.
cancelRules: Exactly one original cancel call; no await, timeout, retry, releaseLock or result changes. RETURNED/old AFTER is not settlement. Missing result is not RESOLVED.
metadataDocsMeaning: Distinct anonymous nonce aliases d observed in SEND/CANCEL_RESULT/NET_START, not DOCUMENT row count; exactly one main DOCUMENT is verified separately.
bindingRules: One exact loopback document, default execution context tied to its main frame; session and protocol IDs stay private aliases.
SEND and NET_START link by the exact unique document/mount/request header, never timestamp proximity or arrival order.
Header matching is case insensitive with exactly one key; duplicate case variants, comma values, redirects, replay or multi-map reject.
Only anonymous fixed status GET carries the header. Protected details, auth/cookies, other origins and other paths never carry it.
Each observed network start must match exactly one JS SEND and original BEGIN; missing JS network records are explicit unbound attempts, not invented starts.
NET_START then at most one HEADERS then exactly one FINISH or FAIL in event order; START.x <= END.x, but do not force HEADERS.x <= END.x.
Cancellation settlement may follow original FINALLY or network terminal; only per-layer order is enforced.
ExtraInfo is optional and unordered; this scope observes Network.requestWillBeSent metadata and does not claim raw on-wire header attestation.
A valid bound NET_FAIL is a diagnostic observation, never browser acceptance. Missing or duplicate mapping refuses complete request-identity proof.
newVitestNames: P1 probe read-only transport adds a binding header only for an opted-in bound anonymous loopback status request
